AI is getting better at remembering you. But who controls what it remembers?

@ZetaChain  × @verona_dev  are running research to find out what people actually want AI to retain.

The difference:

→^ZetaChain securely stores what you share, makes it usable across AI models, and only your key opens it.
→^ Verona uses zero-knowledge proofs to verify facts about you without revealing the data itself.

   Result: AI that's helpful because it remembers, and trustworthy because it can prove things without exposing sensitive details.
   The research covers what AI should and shouldn't remember, how data moves between models, and how permissions are managed and revoked.

The survey is anonymous, needs no account, and takes ~5 minutes. Closes Oct 27, results in November .
